e.title: AI 双轨保险劳动力（亚太）
e.summary: APAC 保险业 AI 双轨劳动力：AI 技能者的市场分化（行业分析）
e.body: AI is creating a two-track insurance workforce across Asia-Pacific（insurancebusinessmag）分析[[asia-insurance|亚太保险]]业的劳动力分化：AI 熟练者与不熟练者进入不同的职业轨道——行业人力市场的结构性变化。对 RIAA：AI 时代职业分化的市场信号——「双轨」意味着 AI 技能决定职业轨道（工具盒里的工具正是分轨的通行证）；与 [[asia-actuarial-job-market]]（亚洲市场情报）、[[hybrid-actuarial-role]]（混合角色）互相印证：AI 从加分项变成分水岭；求职定位的紧迫性信号。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：insurancebusinessmag 文章确认（亚太保险 AI 双轨劳动力），未通读
e.title_hk: AI 雙軌保險勞動力（亞太）
e.summary_en: APAC insurance AI two-track workforce: market divergence of AI-skilled vs non-AI-skilled professionals (industry analysis)
e.summary_hk: APAC 保險業 AI 雙軌勞動力：AI 技能者的市場分化（行業分析）
e.body_en: 'AI is creating a two-track insurance workforce across Asia-Pacific' (insurancebusinessmag) analyses the labour-market divergence in APAC insurance: AI-skilled and non-AI-skilled professionals enter different career tracks — a structural change in the industry's human-capital market. For RIAA: a market signal of AI-era career divergence — 'two tracks' means AI skills determine the career track (the toolbox's tools are exactly the passes to the fast track); mutually corroborating [[asia-actuarial-job-market]] (Asia market intelligence) and [[hybrid-actuarial-role]] (hybrid roles): AI moves from a plus to a watershed; a signal of urgency for career positioning.
e.body_hk: AI is creating a two-track insurance workforce across Asia-Pacific（insurancebusinessmag）分析亞太保險業的勞動力分化：AI 熟練者與不熟練者進入不同的職業軌道——行業人力市場的結構性變化。對 RIAA：AI 時代職業分化的市場信號——「雙軌」意味着 AI 技能決定職業軌道（工具盒裏的工具正是分軌的通行證）；與 [[asia-actuarial-job-market]]（亞洲市場情報）、[[hybrid-actuarial-role]]（混合角色）互相印證：AI 從加分項變成分水嶺；求職定位的緊迫性信號。
